images.scene: Robinson sits alone at the head of a rough table inside his cave dwelling, dining like a solitary king; a parrot perches beside him, an old dog sits at his right hand, and two cats sit on either side of the table looking up for scraps.
images.alt: A castaway dines alone at a table with a parrot, a dog, and two cats around him.

images.scene: Full-length portrait of Robinson standing in his homemade goat-skin outfit: a tall shapeless fur cap with a flap behind, a short goat-skin jacket and open-kneed breeches, a broad belt holding a small saw and hatchet, a basket on his back, a gun on his shoulder, and a clumsy goat-skin umbrella held over his head.
images.alt: A castaway stands dressed head to toe in goat skins, carrying a gun, basket, and fur umbrella.

images.scene: Robinson stops in shock on the empty beach near his boat, staring down at a single clear print of a bare human foot pressed into the wet sand, one hand raised to his face in astonishment.
images.alt: A man stares in shock at a single bare footprint in the sand on an empty shore.

images.scene: Terrified Robinson races back toward his rock-side fortification hidden behind grown-up stakes, glancing over his shoulder in fear as he scrambles to climb the ladder over his wall.
images.alt: A frightened man runs back to his walled shelter, looking over his shoulder.

images.scene: Robinson crouches nervously milking a goat inside his fenced country enclosure, a basket set beside him, his head turned to glance behind him with a fearful expression as the flock stands nearby.
images.alt: A man milks a goat in a fenced enclosure while nervously looking behind him.

images.scene: Robinson works on his thickened semicircular outer wall reinforced with timber and old cables, fitting muskets into wooden frames through seven small loop-holes in the wall of his fortress.
images.alt: A man reinforces a thick defensive wall and sets muskets into holes in it.
